name: Occult Sight, Greater
body:
School divination [pact]; Level sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like occult sight†, except that you automatically know which pactmaking powers or effects are active upon any individual or object you see.

Unlike occult sight, this spell cannot be made permanent with a permanency spell.
